archetypes.rationale: Changed /design final-summary handoffs and paragraph-bound callsite scans.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the /design final-summary binding changes in skills/design/SKILL.md and scripts/test-render-cost-line-callsites.sh. Verify each Gantt-preservation instruction is on the intended binding paragraph only. Confirm the harness cannot pass via cancellation sibling text or adjacent Step 5c bleed, and that diagnostics name the failing site. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
